steps.code:
# Let me parse the old songs list and search for each song on Spotify.
import re

content = file_content["content"]
lines = content.strip().split("\n")
old_songs = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith("- "):
        song_entry = line[2:]
        old_songs.append(song_entry)

print("Old songs to archive:")
for song in old_songs:
    print(f"  - {song}")

# Search for each song
old_song_ids = set()
for song_entry in old_songs:
    # Parse title and artist
    parts = song_entry.split(" by ")
    title = parts[0].strip()
    artists = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else ""
    
    # Search with title and artist
    query = f"{title} {artists}" if artists else title
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
    
    # Find exact match
    for result in results:
        result_title = result["title"].strip()
        result_artists = " ".join([a["name"] for a in result["artists"]])
        if title.lower() == result_title.lower():
            old_song_ids.add(result["song_id"])
            print(f"Found: {title} by {artists} -> song_id={result['song_id']}")
            break

print(f"\nTotal old song IDs found: {len(old_song_ids)}")
print(old_song_ids)

# Now let me go through each playlist, add matching songs to the new playlist, and remove them from the original.
for playlist in all_playlists:
    playlist_id = playlist["playlist_id"]
    song_ids = playlist.get("song_ids", [])
    songs_to_archive = [sid for sid in song_ids if sid in old_song_ids]
    
    if songs_to_archive:
        print(f"Playlist: {playlist['title']} (id={playlist_id})")
        print(f"  Songs to archive: {songs_to_archive}")
        
        # Add songs to archived playlist
        for song_id in songs_to_archive:
            apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=archived_playlist_id, song_id=song_id, access_token=spotify_token)
            print(f"  Added song {song_id} to archived playlist")
        
        # Remove songs from original playlist
        for song_id in songs_to_archive:
            apis.spotify.remove_song_from_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=song_id, access_token=spotify_token)
            print(f"  Removed song {song_id} from playlist {playlist_id}")

print("\nDone!")
